t: The Hager Sollysta WMSSU83FO 13A switched fused spur with flex outlet provides a secure and reliable power supply for permanently wired appliances. Featuring a white finish, its raised slim profile and screwed faceplate ensure a flush fitting. Angled in-line terminals with backed-out captive screws, and a single screw fast-fix cable clamp simplify wiring. Installation requires a 25mm back box.
b: Angled In-Line Terminals with Backed-Out Captive Screws
